faq.a: Suleman is associated with the Arabic form سُلَيْمَان, whose core sense is suleman; solomon (prophet).

faq.q: What is the origin of Suleman?
faq.a: Suleman is associated with Arabic. Suleman is Arabic سُلَيْمَان (Sulaymān), the Quranic form of the prophet Solomon.
Yes — the underlying form سُلَيْمَان is Arabic.
Suleman can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Suleman should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Sulaymān is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Solomon and occurs in the Quran.

faq.q: What does Suleman mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Suleman is rendered سلیمان and carries the sense سلیمان، نبی کا نام.

faq.q: What does Suleman mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Suleman is rendered سلیمان and carries the sense سلیمان، نام پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is su-le-man. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Suleman?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Suleman, suleman. Script forms are سليمان, سلیمان, سُلَيْمَان, सुलेमान.

faq.q: Is Suleman a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
